knight.name: Knight
knight.ab: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.

chef.name: Chef
chef.ab: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.

noble.name: Noble
noble.ab: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.

investigator.name: Investigator
investigator.fn: Show the Minion character token. Point to both the *MINION* and *WRONG* players.
investigator.ab: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.

washerwoman.name: Washerwoman
washerwoman.fn: Show the Townsfolk character token. Point to both the *TOWNSFOLK* and *WRONG* players.
washerwoman.ab: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.

clockmaker.name: Clockmaker
clockmaker.ab: You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.

grandmother.name: Grandmother
grandmother.fn: Point to the grandchild player & show their character token.
grandmother.on: If the grandchild was killed by the Demon, the Grandmother dies too.
grandmother.ab: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.

librarian.name: Librarian
librarian.fn: Show the Outsider character token. Point to both the *OUTSIDER* and *WRONG* players.
librarian.ab: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)

shugenja.name: Shugenja
shugenja.ab: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.

pixie.name: Pixie
pixie.fn: Show the Townsfolk character token marked *MAD*.
pixie.ab: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.

bountyhunter.name: Bounty Hunter
bountyhunter.on: If the player marked *KNOW* died today or tonight, point to the new player marked *KNOW*.
bountyhunter.ab: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]

empath.name: Empath
empath.ab: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.

highpriestess.name: High Priestess
highpriestess.ab: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.fn: The Sailor chooses a living player.
sailor.on: The Sailor chooses a living player.
sailor.ab: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.

balloonist.name: Balloonist
balloonist.on: Point to a player with a different character type to the previously shown player.
balloonist.ab: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]

general.name: General
general.ab: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither.

preacher.name: Preacher
preacher.fn: The Preacher chooses a player. If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.
preacher.on: The Preacher chooses a player. If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.
preacher.ab: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.

chambermaid.name: Chambermaid
chambermaid.fn: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
chambermaid.on: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
chambermaid.ab: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.

villageidiot.name: Village Idiot
villageidiot.fn: If there are multiple Village Idiots, mark one as *DRUNK*. Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.
villageidiot.on: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.
villageidiot.ab: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. [+0 to +2 Village Idiots. 1 of the extras is drunk]

snakecharmer.name: Snake Charmer
snakecharmer.fn: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: Show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep. Wake the old Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* and Snake Charmer tokens & give a thumbs up.
snakecharmer.on: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: Show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep. Wake the old Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* and Snake Charmer tokens & give a thumbs up.
snakecharmer.ab: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.

mathematician.name: Mathematician
mathematician.ab: Each night, you learn how many players’ abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.

king.name: King
king.fn: Wake the Demon: Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & King tokens, then point to the King.
king.on: If the dead equal or outnumber the living, show the character token of a living player.
king.ab: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.

dreamer.name: Dreamer
dreamer.fn: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.
dreamer.on: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.
dreamer.ab: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.

fortuneteller.name: Fortune Teller
fortuneteller.fn: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).
fortuneteller.on: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).
fortuneteller.ab: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.

cultleader.name: Cult Leader
cultleader.fn: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.
cultleader.on: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.
cultleader.ab: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbor. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.

flowergirl.name: Flowergirl
flowergirl.on: Either nod or shake your head.
flowergirl.ab: Each night*, you learn if a Demon voted today.

towncrier.name: Town Crier
towncrier.on: Either nod or shake your head.
towncrier.ab: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.ab: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.

undertaker.name: Undertaker
undertaker.on: If a player was executed today, show their character token.
undertaker.ab: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.

innkeeper.name: Innkeeper
innkeeper.ab: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.

monk.name: Monk
monk.ab: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.on: The Gambler chooses a player & a character.
gambler.ab: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.

acrobat.name: Acrobat
acrobat.ab: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.

exorcist.name: Exorcist
exorcist.on: The Exorcist chooses a player. Put the Exorcist to sleep. If the Exorcist chose the Demon: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Exorcist tokens. Point to the Exorcist.
exorcist.ab: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.

lycanthrope.name: Lycanthrope
lycanthrope.ab: Each night*, choose an alive player. If good, they die & the Demon doesn’t kill tonight. One good player registers as evil.

gossip.name: Gossip
gossip.on: If the Gossip is due to kill a player, they die.
gossip.ab: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.

savant.name: Savant
savant.ab: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.

alsaahir.name: Alsaahir
alsaahir.ab: Each day, if you publicly guess which players are Minion(s) and which are Demon(s), good wins.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.fn: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
engineer.on: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
engineer.ab: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.

nightwatchman.name: Nightwatchman
nightwatchman.fn: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman.
nightwatchman.on: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman.
nightwatchman.ab: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn you are the Nightwatchman.

courtier.name: Courtier
courtier.fn: The Courtier might choose a character.
courtier.on: The Courtier might choose a character.
courtier.ab: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.

seamstress.name: Seamstress
seamstress.fn: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head.
seamstress.on: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head.
seamstress.ab: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.

philosopher.name: Philosopher
philosopher.fn: The Philosopher might choose a character. If necessary, swap their character token.
philosopher.on: The Philosopher might choose a character. If necessary, swap their character token.
philosopher.ab: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.

huntsman.name: Huntsman
huntsman.fn: The Huntsman might choose a player. If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
huntsman.on: The Huntsman might choose a player. If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
huntsman.ab: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]

professor.name: Professor
professor.on: The Professor might choose a dead player.
professor.ab: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.

artist.name: Artist
artist.ab: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.

slayer.name: Slayer
slayer.ab: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.

fisherman.name: Fisherman
fisherman.ab: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.

princess.name: Princess
princess.on: If the Princess nominated the player who was executed today, wake the Demon as normal, but no one dies to the Demon's ability.
princess.ab: On your 1st day, if you nominated & executed a player, the Demon doesn't kill tonight.

juggler.name: Juggler
juggler.ab: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.ab: You are safe from the Demon.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.fn: Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Minion token.
alchemist.ab: You have a Minion ability. When using this, the Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.

cannibal.name: Cannibal
cannibal.ab: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.

amnesiac.name: Amnesiac
amnesiac.fn: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.
amnesiac.on: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.
amnesiac.ab: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.on: If the Farmer died tonight, wake a living good player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Farmer token.
farmer.ab: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.

minstrel.name: Minstrel
minstrel.ab: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.

ravenkeeper.name: Ravenkeeper
ravenkeeper.on: If the Ravenkeeper died tonight, the Ravenkeeper chooses a player. Show that player's character token.
ravenkeeper.ab: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.

sage.name: Sage
sage.on: If the Demon killed the Sage, wake the Sage and point to 2 players, 1 of which is the Demon.
sage.ab: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.

choirboy.name: Choirboy
choirboy.on: If the Demon killed the King, point to the Demon player.
choirboy.ab: If the Demon kills the King, you learn which player is the Demon. [+the King]

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.on: If the Banshee was killed by the Demon tonight, announce that the Banshee has died.
banshee.ab: If the Demon kills you, all players learn this. From now on, you may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.

tealady.name: Tea Lady
tealady.ab: If both your alive neighbors are good, they can't die.

mayor.name: Mayor
mayor.ab: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

fool.name: Fool
fool.ab: The 1st time you die, you don't.

virgin.name: Virgin
virgin.ab: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.

magician.name: Magician
magician.fn: During Minion Info, point to the Magician and the Demon. During Demon Info, point to the Magician and the Minions.
magician.ab: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.

poppygrower.name: Poppy Grower
poppygrower.fn: Skip Minion Info and Demon Info. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
poppygrower.on: If the Poppy Grower died today or tonight, wake all Minions. Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token. Point to the Demon. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to the Minions.
poppygrower.ab: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.

pacifist.name: Pacifist
pacifist.ab: Executed good players might not die.

atheist.name: Atheist
atheist.ab: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]

hermit.name: Hermit
hermit.ab: You have all Outsider abilities. [-0 or -1 Outsider]

butler.name: Butler
butler.ab: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.

goon.name: Goon
goon.ab: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.ab: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): you become their alignment (you don't know which) even if drunk or poisoned.

lunatic.name: Lunatic
lunatic.fn: If there are 7 or more players, wake the Lunatic: Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to any players. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 good character tokens. Put the Lunatic to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and the Demon token. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* info token and the Lunatic token, then point to the Lunatic.
lunatic.on: Do whatever needs to be done to simulate the Demon acting. Put the Lunatic to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the Lunatic token & point to them, then their target(s).
lunatic.ab: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.

drunk.name: Drunk
drunk.ab: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.ab: You might die at any time.

recluse.name: Recluse
recluse.ab: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.

golem.name: Golem
golem.ab: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.

sweetheart.name: Sweetheart
sweetheart.on: If the Sweetheart died, a player became drunk immediately. If you haven't done this yet, do so now.
sweetheart.ab: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.

plaguedoctor.name: Plague Doctor
plaguedoctor.on: If the Plague Doctor died, the Storyteller gained a Minion ability. If you haven’t done this yet, do so now.
plaguedoctor.ab: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.

klutz.name: Klutz
klutz.ab: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.

moonchild.name: Moonchild
moonchild.on: If the Moonchild is due to kill a good player, they die.
moonchild.ab: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.

saint.name: Saint
saint.ab: If you die by execution, your team loses.

barber.name: Barber
barber.on: If the Barber died today or tonight, show the Demon the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barber tokens. If the Demon chose 2 players, wake one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.
barber.ab: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.

hatter.name: Hatter
hatter.on: If the Hatter died, wake the Minions & Demons. Each may choose a new character. If they do, show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.
hatter.ab: If you died today or tonight, the Minion & Demon players may choose new Minion & Demon characters to be.

mutant.name: Mutant
mutant.ab: If you are “mad” about being an Outsider, you might be executed.

politician.name: Politician
politician.ab: If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.

zealot.name: Zealot
zealot.ab: If there are 5 or more players alive, you must vote for every nomination.

damsel.name: Damsel
damsel.fn: During Minion Info, show the Minions the Damsel token. If you haven't done this yet, do so now. If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
damsel.on: If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
damsel.ab: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.

snitch.name: Snitch
snitch.fn: Wake each Minion. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play character tokens.

heretic.name: Heretic
heretic.ab: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.

puzzlemaster.name: Puzzlemaster
puzzlemaster.ab: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.

mezepheles.name: Mezepheles
mezepheles.on: If a good player said the secret word, wake the player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumbs-down.
mezepheles.ab: You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.

godfather.name: Godfather
godfather.fn: Show the character tokens of all in-play Outsiders.
godfather.on: If an Outsider died today, the Godfather chooses a player.
godfather.ab: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]

poisoner.name: Poisoner
poisoner.ab: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.

devilsadvocate.name: Devil's Advocate
devilsadvocate.fn: The Devil's Advocate chooses a living player.
devilsadvocate.on: The Devil's Advocate chooses a living player.
devilsadvocate.ab: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.

spy.name: Spy
spy.fn: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
spy.on: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
spy.ab: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.fn: The Harpy chooses 2 players. Put the Harpy to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Harpy token, then point to the 2nd target.
harpy.on: The Harpy chooses 2 players. Put the Harpy to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Harpy token, then point to the 2nd target.
harpy.ab: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is mad that the 2nd is evil, or one or both might die.

witch.name: Witch
witch.ab: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.

cerenovus.name: Cerenovus
cerenovus.fn: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
cerenovus.on: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
cerenovus.ab: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.

fearmonger.name: Fearmonger
fearmonger.fn: The Fearmonger chooses a player. Announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.
fearmonger.on: The Fearmonger chooses a player. If the target is different to last night, announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.
fearmonger.ab: Each night, choose a player: if you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.

pithag.name: Pit-Hag
pithag.on: The Pit-Hag chooses a player & a character. If they chose a character that is not in play: Put the Pit-Hag to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.
pithag.ab: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

psychopath.name: Psychopath
psychopath.ab: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.on: The Assassin might choose a player.
assassin.ab: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.fn: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.
wizard.on: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.
wizard.ab: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature.

widow.name: Widow
widow.fn: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Widow needs. The Widow chooses a player. Put the Widow to sleep. Wake the player marked *KNOW* & show the Widow token.
widow.ab: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose a player: they are poisoned. 1 good player knows a Widow is in play.

xaan.name: Xaan
xaan.fn: If X is 1, mark the Xaan with the *X* reminder token.
xaan.on: Change the Xaan reminder token to the relevant night. If it is night X, mark the Xaan with the *X* reminder token.
xaan.ab: On night X, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk. [X Outsiders]

marionette.name: Marionette
marionette.fn: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Marionette tokens. Point to the Marionette.
marionette.ab: You think you are a good character, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. [You neighbor the Demon]

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.fn: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.
wraith.on: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.
wraith.ab: You may choose to open your eyes at night. You wake when other evil players do.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.fn: Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
summoner.on: Change the Summoner reminder token to the relevant night. If it is night 3, the Summoner chooses a player & a Demon character. Put the Summoner to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Demon tokens & give a thumbs-down.
summoner.ab: You get 3 bluffs. On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. [No Demon]

eviltwin.name: Evil Twin
eviltwin.fn: Wake both twins. Allow eye contact. Show the good twin's character token to the Evil Twin & vice versa.
eviltwin.ab: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.ab: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.

boomdandy.name: Boomdandy
boomdandy.ab: If you are executed, all but 3 players die. After a 10 to 1 countdown, the player with the most players pointing at them, dies.

mastermind.name: Mastermind
mastermind.ab: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.

scarletwoman.name: Scarlet Woman
scarletwoman.on: If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon today, show them the *YOU ARE* token, then the Demon token.
scarletwoman.ab: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)

vizier.name: Vizier
vizier.fn: Announce which player is the Vizier.
vizier.ab: All players know you are the Vizier. You cannot die during the day. If good voted, you may choose to execute immediately.

organgrinder.name: Organ Grinder
organgrinder.fn: The Organ Grinder either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober.
organgrinder.on: The Organ Grinder either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober.
organgrinder.ab: All players keep their eyes closed when voting and the vote tally is secret. Each night, choose if you are drunk until dusk.

boffin.name: Boffin
boffin.fn: Wake the Boffin and the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Boffin tokens, then the not-in-play good character token.
boffin.ab: The Demon (even if drunk or poisoned) has a not-in-play good character’s ability. You both know which.

baron.name: Baron
baron.ab: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

yaggababble.name: Yaggababble
yaggababble.fn: Show the Yaggababble their secret phrase.
yaggababble.on: For each time the Yaggababble said their phrase today, a player might die.
yaggababble.ab: You start knowing a secret phrase. For each time you said it publicly today, a player might die.

pukka.name: Pukka
pukka.on: The Pukka chooses a player. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
pukka.ab: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.

lilmonsta.name: Lil' Monsta
lilmonsta.fn: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens.
lilmonsta.on: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens. A player might die.
lilmonsta.ab: Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. [+1 Minion]

nodashii.name: No Dashii
nodashii.on: The No Dashii chooses a player.
nodashii.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.

imp.name: Imp
imp.on: The Imp chooses a player. If the Imp chose themselves: Replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Imp token. Put the old Imp to sleep. Wake the new Imp. Show the *YOU ARE* token, then show the Imp token.
imp.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.

shabaloth.name: Shabaloth
shabaloth.on: A previously chosen player might be resurrected. The Shabaloth chooses 2 players.
shabaloth.ab: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.

ojo.name: Ojo
ojo.ab: Each night*, choose a character: they die. If they are not in play, the Storyteller chooses who dies.

kazali.name: Kazali
kazali.fn: The Kazali chooses which players are which Minions. Wake each target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
kazali.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [You choose which players are which Minions. -? to +? Outsiders]

po.name: Po
po.on: The Po may choose a player OR chooses 3 players if they chose no-one last night. or
po.ab: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.

zombuul.name: Zombuul
zombuul.on: If no one died today, the Zombuul chooses a player.
zombuul.ab: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.

vigormortis.name: Vigormortis
vigormortis.on: The Vigormortis chooses a player. If that player is a Minion, poison a neighboring Townsfolk.
vigormortis.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]

vortox.name: Vortox
vortox.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.

legion.name: Legion
legion.ab: Each night*, a player might die. Executions fail if only evil voted. You register as a Minion too. [Most players are Legion]

fanggu.name: Fang Gu
fanggu.on: The Fang Gu chooses a player. If they chose an Outsider (once only): Replace the Outsider token with the spare Fang Gu token. Put the Fang Gu to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Fang Gu tokens & give a thumbs-down.
fanggu.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]

lordoftyphon.name: Lord of Typhon
lordoftyphon.fn: Wake the Lord of Typhon's neighbors. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
lordoftyphon.on: The Lord of Typhon chooses a player.
lordoftyphon.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [Evil characters are in a line. You are in the middle. +1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders]

lleech.name: Lleech
lleech.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You start by choosing a player: they are poisoned. You die if & only if they are dead.

alhadikhia.name: Al-Hadikhia
alhadikhia.on: The Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 players. In order, wake each target. They nod or shake their head. Put them to sleep before waking the next target.
alhadikhia.ab: Each night*, you may choose 3 players (all players learn who): each silently chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.

riot.name: Riot
riot.on: Change the Riot reminder token to the relevant day. If it is night 3, you may wake the Minions. Show the *YOU ARE* & Riot tokens.
riot.ab: On day 3, Minions become Riot & nominees die but nominate an alive player immediately. This must happen.

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.fn: Announce that the Leviathan is in play.
leviathan.on: Change the Leviathan reminder token to the relevant day. You may announce that the Leviathan is in play.
leviathan.ab: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.

thief.name: Thief
thief.ab: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.

bureaucrat.name: Bureaucrat
bureaucrat.ab: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.

barista.name: Barista
barista.fn: Choose a player. Wake them, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barista tokens, then give a finger signal.
barista.on: Choose a player. Wake them, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barista tokens, then give a finger signal.
barista.ab: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.

harlot.name: Harlot
harlot.on: The Harlot chooses a living player. Put the Harlot to sleep. Wake the chosen player, show them the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, then the Harlot token. If that player nods their head, wake the Harlot and show them the chosen player's character token. Both players might die.
harlot.ab: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.ab: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.

cacklejack.name: Cacklejack
cacklejack.on: Before dawn, choose a player not marked *NOT ME*. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
cacklejack.ab: Each day, choose a player: a different player changes character tonight.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.ab: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.

matron.name: Matron
matron.ab: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.

gangster.name: Gangster
gangster.ab: Once per day, you may choose to kill an alive neighbor, if your other alive neighbor agrees.

bonecollector.name: Bone Collector
bonecollector.on: The Bone Collector might choose a dead player. If necessary, wake the chosen player to use their ability.
bonecollector.ab: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.

judge.name: Judge
judge.ab: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.

apprentice.name: Apprentice
apprentice.fn: Show the *YOU ARE* info token, then a Townsfolk or Minion token. Swap the Apprentice & Townsfolk or Minion tokens.
apprentice.ab: On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good), or a Minion ability (if evil).

beggar.name: Beggar
beggar.ab: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.

deviant.name: Deviant
deviant.ab: If you were funny today, you cannot die by exile.

scapegoat.name: Scapegoat
scapegoat.ab: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.

gnome.name: Gnome
gnome.ab: All players start knowing a player of your alignment. You may choose to kill anyone who nominates them.

bishop.name: Bishop
bishop.ab: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.

voudon.name: Voudon
voudon.ab: Only you & the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority isn't required.

angel.name: Angel
angel.fn: Announce which players are protected by the Angel.
angel.ab: Something bad might happen to whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player.

buddhist.name: Buddhist
buddhist.fn: Announce which players are affected by the Buddhist.
buddhist.ab: For the first 2 minutes of each day, veteran players may not talk.

deusexfiasco.name: Deus ex Fiasco
deusexfiasco.ab: At least once per game, the Storyteller will make a mistake, correct it, and publicly admit to it.

djinn.name: Djinn
djinn.ab: Use the Djinn's special rule. All players know what it is.

doomsayer.name: Doomsayer
doomsayer.ab: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.

duchess.name: Duchess
duchess.on: One at a time: Wake each player marked *VISITOR* or *FALSE INFO*. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Duchess tokens, then give a finger signal.
duchess.ab: Each day, 3 players may choose to visit you. At night*, each visitor learns how many visitors are evil, but 1 gets false info.

ferryman.name: Ferryman
ferryman.ab: On the final day, all dead players regain their vote token.

fibbin.name: Fibbin
fibbin.ab: Once per game, 1 good player might get incorrect information.

fiddler.name: Fiddler
fiddler.ab: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players choose which of these 2 players win.

hellslibrarian.name: Hell's Librarian
hellslibrarian.ab: Something bad might happen to whoever talks when the Storyteller has asked for silence.

revolutionary.name: Revolutionary
revolutionary.ab: 2 neighboring players are known to be the same alignment. Once per game, 1 of them registers falsely.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.ab: There might be 1 extra or 1 fewer Outsider in play.

spiritofivory.name: Spirit of Ivory
spiritofivory.ab: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.

toymaker.name: Toymaker
toymaker.fn: Resolve Minion Info and Demon Info, even though there are fewer than 7 players.
toymaker.on: If a Demon attack could end the game, and the Demon is marked *FINAL NIGHT: NO ATTACK*, do not wake the Demon.
toymaker.ab: The Demon may choose not to attack & must do this at least once per game. Evil players get normal starting info.

bigwig.name: Big Wig
bigwig.ab: Each nominee chooses a player: until voting, only they may speak & they are mad the nominee is good or they might die.

bootlegger.name: Bootlegger
bootlegger.ab: This script has homebrew characters or rules.

gardener.name: Gardener
gardener.ab: The Storyteller assigns all players' characters.

godofug.name: God of Ug
godofug.ab: One Ug hat. When wear Ug hat, must speak one sound at a time but vote twice. If fail, pass Ug hat.

hindu.name: Hindu
hindu.ab: The first 4 players to die are immediately reincarnated as Travellers of the same alignment.

knaves.name: Knaves
knaves.ab: There are 2 Storytellers: one lies & one tells the truth. Once per game, at dusk, they might switch.

pope.name: Pope
pope.ab: There are duplicate good characters in play. They might also be bluffs.

stormcatcher.name: Storm Catcher
stormcatcher.fn: Announce which character is stormcaught. If that character is in play, mark that player as *STORMCAUGHT*. Wake each evil player and show them the character token, then the marked player.  If not in play, wake each evil player, show them the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token & the relevant character token.
stormcatcher.ab: Name a good character. If in play, they can only die by execution, but evil players learn which player it is.

tor.name: Tor
tor.fn: Skip Minion Info and Demon Info.
tor.on: If a player died tonight, show the *YOU ARE* info token, their character token, & give a thumb signal.
tor.ab: Players don't know their character or alignment. They learn them when they die.

ventriloquist.name: Ventriloquist
ventriloquist.ab: If a player is mad as a fresh character during their nomination, they might not die if executed today.

zenomancer.name: Zenomancer
zenomancer.ab: One or more players each have a goal. When achieved, that player learns a piece of true info.
